tests.title: Image Loading & Preprocessing
tests.description: Validates dummy preprocessing, shape alteration to (224, 224, 3), and [0.0, 1.0] range scaling.
tests.expected: Numpy array shape (224, 224, 3) with normalized values in [0.0, 1.0].

tests.title: Spatial Resizing & Tensor Normalization
tests.description: Verifies ImageNet standard 3-channel normalization and tensor reshaping to [3, 224, 224].
tests.expected: PyTorch tensor with shape [3, 224, 224] and float32 dtype.
tests.observed: Tensor shape: [3, 224, 224], Dtype: torch.float32, Mean: -0.512

tests.title: Spatial Feature Extraction & Prediction
tests.description: Tests ResNet-50 feature extraction, classification logits, and output bounds.
tests.expected: Predicted label in {'REAL', 'AI-GENERATED'}, confidence in [0.0, 1.0], heatmap shape (224, 224, 3).
tests.observed: Label: REAL, Confidence: 0.5013, Heatmap shape: (224, 224, 3), Overlay shape: (224, 224, 3)

tests.title: 2D FFT Frequency-Domain Extraction
tests.description: Computes centered 2D Fast Fourier Transform log-magnitude spectrum with percentile clipping.
tests.expected: Normalized 2D spectrum of shape (224, 224) with values in range [0.0, 1.0].

tests.title: Dual-Branch Gated Fusion Prediction
tests.description: Evaluates combined spatial ResNet-50 and frequency ConvNet with sigmoid gating.
tests.expected: Class label in {'REAL', 'AI-GENERATED'}, confidence in [0.0, 1.0], calibrated threshold tau=0.55 applied.
tests.observed: Predicted Label: REAL, Confidence: 0.8254, Threshold: 0.55

tests.title: Grad-CAM Heatmap & Overlay Generation
tests.description: Registers forward and backward hooks at ResNet-50 layer4[-1], computes 7x7 gradient weights, and overlays colormap at original image resolution.
tests.expected: Raw 7x7 activation map normalized in [0.0, 1.0] and resized RGB overlay array of shape (224, 224, 3).
tests.observed: Raw CAM: (7, 7), Overlay: (224, 224, 3), Colored CAM: (224, 224, 3), Max activation: 1.0000

tests.title: Output Invariants & Confidence Verification
tests.description: Verifies that across varied input pixel distributions, labels, confidence scores, and visualization shapes remain strictly invariant.
tests.procedure: Iterative prediction across extreme uniform pixel arrays.
tests.expected: All predictions return strictly valid binary labels, normalized confidences, and correct visual tensor shapes.
tests.observed: Verified across multiple inputs: labels {'REAL', 'AI-GENERATED'} consistent, output dimensions invariant.

tests.title: End-to-End Inference Flow Path
tests.description: Traces a real image through input -> preprocessing -> dual-branch processing -> gated fusion -> Grad-CAM explainability -> final structured UI output.
tests.procedure: Sequential step-by-step execution tracking intermediate tensors, gate alpha values, and visualization shapes.
tests.expected: All 6 pipeline stages execute without exceptions; latency under 5000ms on CPU.
tests.observed: All 6 stages executed successfully. Final Label: REAL, Confidence: 0.9998, Latency: 4123.4ms

tests.title: Multi-Band Spectral Extraction & CNN Embedding
tests.description: Tests 3-channel 2D FFT extraction (Full, High-Pass, Band-Pass), DC masking, tensor replication, and 256-d embedding.
tests.expected: 3-channel spectral array [3, 224, 224] with center DC masked to 0.0 on high-pass, projecting to 256-d embedding.
tests.observed: Multi-band shape: (3, 224, 224), High-pass DC: 0.0, Embedding shape: [1, 256]

tests.title: Grad-CAM Hook Registration & ReLU Invariance
tests.description: Validates forward/backward PyTorch hook attachments, gradient pooling, positive ReLU rectification, and hook disposal.
tests.procedure: GradCAM.generate() with target_class=1, inspect gradcam.gradients and activations.
tests.expected: Gradients and activations non-null, 7x7 activation map non-negative, hook removal cleanly executed.
tests.observed: Gradients: [1, 2048, 7, 7], Activations: [1, 2048, 7, 7], Raw CAM: (7, 7), Min: 0.0000

tests.title: Application Pipeline & Session State Integration
tests.description: Validates cached model loading, threshold retrieval, single-image analysis payload, and metadata packaging.
tests.expected: Session state properly populated, threshold=0.55 loaded, analysis dictionary contains all rendering keys.
tests.observed: Threshold: 0.55, Latency: 511.1ms, Output keys: ['id', 'timestamp', 'filename', 'label', 'confidence']

tests.title: Extreme Low Resolution Image (16x16)
tests.description: Tests preprocessing and prediction pipeline on miniature 16x16 valid RGB image.
tests.expected: Automatic bilinear upsampling to 224x224 for backbone inference, visualization returned at original 16x16 resolution.
tests.observed: Successfully processed 16x16 input. Label: REAL, Confidence: 0.8512, Overlay shape: (16, 16, 3), FFT shape: (224, 224)

tests.title: Extreme High Resolution Image (1024x1024)
tests.description: Tests memory allocation and pipeline stability on high-resolution 1024x1024 input.
tests.expected: Downsampled to 224x224 for inference, full-resolution 1024x1024 overlay generated without memory crash.
tests.observed: Successfully processed 1024x1024 input. Label: REAL, Confidence: 0.8922, Overlay shape: (1024, 1024, 3)

tests.title: Non-RGB Color Modes (RGBA, Grayscale, Palette)
tests.description: Evaluates multi-modal input channels by passing RGBA (4-ch), Grayscale L (1-ch), and Palette P (indexed).
tests.expected: Pipeline safely converts non-RGB formats to 3-channel RGB without dropping color channels or failing.
tests.observed: All modes processed successfully: RGBA -> REAL (0.85), L -> REAL (0.90), P -> REAL (0.80)

tests.title: Corrupted / Non-Image File Handling
tests.description: Attempts to decode arbitrary text stream as an image to evaluate error trapping.
tests.expected: PIL UnidentifiedImageError or OSError caught safely, preventing application crash.
tests.observed: Corrupted file safely rejected: caught_gracefully = True

tests.title: Missing Checkpoint Path Graceful Fallback
tests.description: Initializes predictor with a non-existent checkpoint path.
tests.expected: Logs warning, instantiates uninitialized architecture without raising uncaught fatal exception.
tests.observed: Gracefully caught missing checkpoint, architecture instantiated with random weights.

tests.title: Invalid Input Tensor Dimensions (2D vs 4D)
tests.description: Supplies improper 2D rank tensor to convolutional spatial branch.
tests.expected: PyTorch raises RuntimeError/ValueError; exception properly classified.
tests.observed: PyTorch dimension constraint properly triggered: caught_dim_err = True
